method: One EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS immediately after each query on the 268-document fixture corpus. Warm caches are possible; these plans demonstrate execution shapes, not production latency.

cases.name: word_start
cases.sql: SELECT "tinkick_test_documents".*, tin.score("tinkick_test_documents".ctid) AS _tinkick_score FROM "tinkick_test_documents" WHERE (TRUE) AND (("tinkick_test_documents"."body" ==> $1)) ORDER BY _tinkick_score DESC LIMIT $2

cases.name: exact
cases.sql: SELECT "tinkick_test_documents".*, 1.0 AS _tinkick_score FROM "tinkick_test_documents" WHERE (TRUE) AND (("tinkick_test_documents"."title"::text COLLATE "C" = $1)) ORDER BY _tinkick_score DESC LIMIT $2

cases.name: mixed
cases.sql:
WITH "_tinkick_matches" AS ( SELECT "tinkick_test_documents"."id" AS _tinkick_id, tin.full_score("tinkick_test_documents".ctid) AS _tinkick_branch_score FROM "tinkick_test_documents" WHERE (TRUE) AND (("tinkick_test_documents"."body" ==> $1)) UNION ALL SELECT "tinkick_test_documents"."id" AS _tinkick_id, 1.0 AS _tinkick_branch_score FROM "tinkick_test_documents" WHERE (TRUE) AND (("public".unaccent(lower(("tinkick_test_documents"."title")::text)) COLLATE "C" LIKE $2)) ) SELECT "tinkick_test_documents".*, _tinkick_ranked.score AS _tinkick_score FROM "tinkick_test_documents" INNER JOIN (
  SELECT _tinkick_id, SUM(_tinkick_branch_score) AS score
  FROM _tinkick_matches GROUP BY _tinkick_id
) AS _tinkick_ranked ON _tinkick_ranked._tinkick_id = "tinkick_test_documents"."id" ORDER BY _tinkick_score DESC LIMIT $3
